summary: Willow Voice vs superwhisper, updated for October 2026: find out which Mac dictation tool fits your team's speed and privacy needs.
body_markdown:
If you manage a team seeking better[voice-to-text](https://willowvoice.com/) functionality, you have likely tested both Willow Voice and superwhisper. This comparison helps engineering leads, product managers, and IT buyers understand which tool fits their organizational deployment needs. Both tools are fast, but they take different approaches to enterprise readiness and team deployment.


**TLDR**


-


The team-focused tool wins for team deployment with ~200ms latency, no per-user setup, and cross-device vocabulary sync across Windows, Mac, and iOS.


-


superwhisper fits users who want offline use, local models, and custom modes on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android.


-


On security, superwhisper processes on-device by default, while the team-focused tool is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant with zero data retention and an Offline Mode on Mac and iOS.


-


On pricing, the team-focused tool offers Team plans at $10 per user per month billed annually as the primary paid option, with an Individual plan at $12/month billed annually and an unlimited free plan as an on-ramp for solo evaluation (paid plans add faster, more accurate dictation and unlimited Willow Scribe), while superwhisper costs $8.49/month, $84.99/year, or $249.99 for lifetime access.


-


Choose based on whether you are rolling out voice to a whole team or configuring a tool for yourself.

## How Does superwhisper Work?


superwhisper is an AI speech-to-text app for macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android that goes beyond basic dictation to understand context. Users choose from built-in modes or build custom profiles with personalized AI instructions, turning raw speech into polished emails, notes, or structured text. It can run fully offline, so users can speak securely without relying on internet connectivity.


The free tier gives unlimited dictation with local Whisper models and up to two modes without AI processing, while Pro adds cloud models, AI-powered modes, and unlimited custom modes. Activation is a keyboard shortcut, and auto-activation rules can switch modes by app or website, though building and tuning those modes takes upfront setup.


## How Does Willow Voice Work?


Willow Voice is AI dictation built for organizations that need fast, accurate, and secure voice input in every app. It turns your voice into clear, formatted writing while keeping sensitive data secure under strict compliance standards.


Press the fn key on Mac or Win + Left Shift on Windows to start, no app switching needed. The context-aware engine structures emails, applies proper medical or technical terminology, and adapts tone based on context. You can[compare the top Mac dictation software](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-voice-to-text-software-mac) to see how it stacks up. For engineering organizations, clinical staff, and enterprise teams, Willow Voice helps people dictate documentation, code reviews, and cross-device workflows roughly 3x faster than they type. The[manifesto](https://willowvoice.com/manifesto) explains why voice is the most fluid input method, and[Thousands use Willow to work faster](https://willowvoice.com/case-study) across mixed-device fleets.


## Head-to-Head: Willow Voice vs. superwhisper


### Performance: Dictation Speed and Accuracy


Willow Voice delivers ~200ms latency, so text appears as you speak it, whether you are drafting a patient chart, an executive email, or a pull request. In September 2026 testing, Willow held 190 to 230 ms from short to long dictations, while superwhisper ran 480 to 900 ms (see the[dictation accuracy and speed benchmark](https://willowvoice.com/blog/dictation-accuracy-zero-edit-rate-benchmark) ). Accuracy sits at 98%+, with 3x fewer errors than built-in voice tools. The context-aware AI reads your active work to correctly capture technical terms and medical jargon, and codebase auto-tagging in Cursor and Windsurf pulls terminology directly from open files for developers. Shared custom dictionaries sync across the entire organization, so that accuracy scales for every team member from day one.


superwhisper speed varies by model, device, and whether local or cloud processing is used. Its docs rate the larger local Whisper models slower than the small ones, and rate its cloud S1-Voice model fastest, so older hardware feels the difference most on large local models.


### Installation and Ease of Use


superwhisper's setup involves configuring permissions and selecting audio devices. An earlier Mac review noted that switching between recording modes could be cumbersome, though current versions add[auto-activation rules](https://superwhisper.com/docs/modes/switching-modes) that switch modes by app or website.


> Willow is optimized to have an Apple-like experience with no crazy setup, no weird customization: it's easy to use and just works.


After a quick download and onboarding, Function key activation works right away, and you speak into Gmail, Slack, Notion, ChatGPT, or anywhere you type.


### Security, Privacy, and Compliance


superwhisper processes locally by default, so voice data stays on the device, with optional cloud processing available for teams needing larger models.


Willow Voice is SOC 2 Type II and[HIPAA compliant](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/security/laws-regulations/index.html) , with a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) available for clinical workflows. Our[voice dictation security and privacy guide](https://willowvoice.com/blog/voice-dictation-security-privacy-guide) covers how these protections work in practice. The hybrid architecture delivers ~200ms latency while audio is processed and instantly discarded under a zero data retention policy. With Privacy Mode on by default, nothing from your dictation sessions is retained, and admins can enforce it across the whole organization. For organizations with strict local processing mandates, Willow Voice also offers an Offline Mode on Mac and iOS for fully private dictation without any cloud dependency.

## Why Willow Voice Is the Better Choice


### Frictionless Workflows for Professionals


superwhisper's many options can add extra setup steps for users who prefer a simpler experience. Willow's hotkey activation and immediate text conversion let you speak at 150 words per minute versus typing at 40, a direct 3x boost with no complex configuration required.


### Context-Aware Intelligence


Willow's context-aware AI, shared custom dictionaries, team leaderboards, and admin controls keep output consistent across the entire organization, adapting tone automatically by app. Say "hey just checking in on that proposal" into a client email and Willow delivers a polished opener like "I wanted to follow up on the proposal we discussed." Say the same thing into Slack, and it lands as "hey, just checking in on that proposal," relaxed and natural, no edits needed.

With SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA compliance, and zero data retention, teams can deploy Willow Voice across mixed-device fleets.


### **Universal Application Support**


> **Windows Support:** Willow Voice runs natively on Windows with the same core dictation features and about 200ms latency as Mac. Offline Mode is the one exception, available on Mac and iOS only.


Willow Voice covers Mac, Windows, and iOS with the same core dictation and team features, so mixed-device teams can standardize on one tool. Windows users get a native app with the Win + Left Shift hotkey to speak text into any application.


On iPhone, a dedicated iOS custom keyboard integrates into any app. Vocabulary and settings sync automatically across Mac, Windows, and iOS, so a doctor can start charting on a Windows workstation and finish on an iPad with the same personalized accuracy.

## FAQs


### What is the best dictation tool for iOS in 2026?


Both Willow Voice and superwhisper offer dedicated iOS apps for users who need more than Apple's built-in keyboard mic. Willow Voice provides a custom keyboard with the same context-aware AI and shared vocabulary as its desktop version, so custom terms and client names transcribe consistently across devices. superwhisper also runs on iOS, with both local and cloud processing options available.


### What is the best dictation tool for LinkedIn posts and messages?


Both Willow Voice and superwhisper work system-wide, typing directly into LinkedIn's web editor for posts, connection messages, or replies. Willow's context-aware engine applies a professional tone when it detects a public-facing context, so spoken input lands as polished prose rather than casual transcription. For founders and sales teams posting at volume, speaking at 150 words per minute beats typing.


### What are the best VoiceInk alternatives for Mac and Windows?


VoiceInk is an open-source Mac tool with local processing and a one-time payment. Alternatives include Willow Voice, the strongest fit for teams and compliance, with shared dictionaries, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, zero data retention, and native Windows support; superwhisper, local-first with deeper model customization and a lifetime option; Wispr Flow, a minimal cloud-based pick; and TalkTastic, a lightweight Mac-only tool.


## Final Thoughts on Mac AI Dictation Tools


Both tools offer compelling alternatives to Apple's built-in dictation, but they suit different needs. Individuals who want local control and offline processing should pick superwhisper. Teams that need speed, compliance, and shared vocabulary across devices fit Willow Voice, a simple[AI dictation tool](https://willowvoice.com/) built for reliable voice-to-text without complex configuration. For teams still weighing speed, compliance, and shared vocabulary across devices, Willow Voice offers a path to resolving all three at once.
